name: Software names of SWA database items (inferred title)
purpose: Inferred from the data; not documented in any available ICD. Found only in the Solar Wind Analyser (SWA) instrument database delivered as ASCII files. It has the same three-column shape as the spacecraft MIB's ASW_sw_para.dat: column 1 is an item name of the SWA database (1,758 monitoring parameters, 428 command parameters and 184 commands match pcf, cpc and ccf), column 2 is always empty, and column 3 holds either a software or display name (e.g. SID, vBM_EAS1, HV_MCP_V_MON, or 'SWA_TC_SYS_CFG_REQ: SWA TC report configuration parameters' for commands) or the placeholder 'a' (2,463 of 2,841 rows). It is presumably the instrument team's contribution to the spacecraft-level ASW_sw_para file, delivered before the software names were filled in (inference). SCOS-2000 does not use it.

fields.name: COL1
fields.description: Inferred: SWA database item name (unique). Matches pcf.PCF_NAME (1,758), cpc.CPC_PNAME (428) and ccf.CCF_CNAME (184) of the SWA database; the rest match none.

fields.name: COL2
fields.description: Inferred: software name column, empty in all rows (by analogy with ASW_sw_para COL2).

fields.name: COL3
fields.description: Inferred: software/display name or description; 'a' is a placeholder in 2,463 rows; five rows hold 'x'.

relationships.note: Inferred from name matches in the SWA database.
Same structure as the spacecraft MIB table (inferred).

history: Not part of any ICD issue nor of pyscos2000. SWA database only (file dated 2021-12-03, 2,841 rows).
notes: All meanings inferred. The solo_stats block here describes the SWA instrument database (swa-idb.sqlite), not the spacecraft MIB.
